pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 12-week trial with 3 monthly gluteal IM injections; oral aripiprazole 15 mg/day co-administered for first 3 weeks
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change from baseline to Day 85 in PANSS total score (ANCOVA, LOCF, Full Analysis Set)
pivotal_trials.result: LS mean difference vs. placebo (CHW method): -10.9 (441 mg, p<0.001) and -11.9 (882 mg, p<0.001); all-subjects ANCOVA LS mean change from baseline at Day 85: -20.9 (441 mg) and -21.8 (882 mg) vs. -9.8 (placebo)

boxed_warning.content: Increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis
boxed_warning.full_text:
WARNING: INCREASED MORTALITY IN ELDERLY PATIENTS WITH DEMENTIA-RELATED PSYCHOSIS

Elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis treated with antipsychotic drugs are at an increased risk of death. ARISTADA is not approved for the treatment of patients with dementia-related psychosis.

key_safety: The most common AE exceeding 5% and at least twice placebo rate was akathisia (11.6% at 441 mg, 11.5% at 882 mg vs. 4.3% placebo); other TEAEs ≥2% more frequent than placebo included injection site pain, weight increase, nausea, blood CPK increased, and sedation.
target_moa: Prodrug of aripiprazole; aripiprazole acts as a partial agonist at dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT1A receptors and as an antagonist at serotonin 5-HT2A receptors

_meta.indication: ARISTADA is indicated for treatment of schizophrenia.

supplements.description: Approved a new 1064 mg dose strength of ARISTADA (aripiprazole lauroxil) that extends the dosing interval to every 2 months.
